sources.title: Intent Detection using XLM-Roberta - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains code and resources for building an Intent Detection model using the XLM-Roberta architecture. Intent detection is a common task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), where the goal is to determine the intent or purpose behind a user's input. In this project, we leverage the power of the Hugging Face Transformers library to fine-tune an XLM-Roberta model for intent ...

sources.snippet: RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach) is an encoder-only transformer model developed by Meta AI to improve the performance of the BERT model through optimized pretraining strategies.
